mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up our time with the story of Malcolm X, let’s really think about what his journey means for you and me—right here, right now. Malcolm’s life wasn’t just about his own transformation. It’s a living reminder that meaning, justice, and self-respect are within reach for anyone willing to look for them, even in a world that doesn’t always make it easy. His courage, his willingness to question, and his relentless drive to grow—these aren’t just traits to admire. They’re steps you can take, too. So, what can we carry forward from his example? Growth starts the moment you’re brave enough to challenge old beliefs and welcome new ideas. True leadership isn’t just about speaking with conviction—it’s about listening, really listening, to those around you. And real courage? It’s moving forward for what’s right, even when you’re scared or unsure. Faith and community—they’re the anchors that’ll help you weather even the toughest storms. And never forget, your story—yes, yours—has the power to spark change in someone else. If you ever feel weighed down by doubt, anger, or like you just don’t fit in, remember: transformation isn’t just for the extraordinary. It’s something you build, moment by moment, with honesty, reflection, and the courage to keep going. Malcolm X shows us that even our deepest scars can be turned into strength. And every step you take toward justice matters. You don’t have to be perfect to make a difference. All you need is the willingness to learn, to grow, and to stand up for what really matters. So, carry that torch—let hope and change guide your way, and let your own story become part of something bigger. The journey continues, and it’s yours to shape.
